*Kusalattika, Sanidassanaduka* (Patthana 16.8) is a canonical Theravāda Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna*. Structurally, the text treats the intersection of the triad on the wholesome (*kusalattika*) with the dyad concerning the visible or demonstrative (*sanidassanaduka*), systematically expounding conditional relations across the matrix of dhammas.
